title: 光學鄰近修正
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究成像誤差、模型校準、局部修正、窗口驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: imaging error, model calibration, local correction, window validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設目標晶圓邊緣 x=100 nm，初始模擬位置 x=94 nm。採用局部線性教學模型：4 倍縮小光罩的邊緣移動 +8 nm，晶圓邊緣只移動 +2 nm。一次修正後位置為 96 nm，帶符號誤差由 -6 nm 變為 -4 nm。不要把光罩 +8 nm 直接加到晶圓；實際 OPC 須重新模擬鄰近耦合，不能永遠沿用此固定斜率。
steps.instructionEn:
Update edges iteratively and track error convergence. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Oversized updates can cause oscillation.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Let the wafer target edge be x=100 nm and the initial prediction x=94 nm. In a local linear teaching model with 4× mask reduction, moving a mask edge +8 nm shifts the wafer edge only +2 nm. The new prediction is 96 nm and signed error changes from -6 to -4 nm. Do not add mask displacement directly to the wafer. Real OPC needs neighborhood resimulation instead of assuming this slope always holds.
